podcast.title: Dispute over Tape Ownership
podcast.body: The unique funding method later led to a legal dispute regarding the actual ownership of the early demo tapes that were released through the label. "Now that would later be an issue when there was a dispute over who actually owned these tapes."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Rise and Fall and Rise of Blink 182 Part 1

podcast.title: Founded by Mark Hoppas's Boss
podcast.body: Filter Records was an independent label established by Mark Hoppas's boss at the record store where he worked, and it was funded using the boss's personal savings. "A label was formed by Mark's boss at the record store where he worked. He called it Filter Records, which he funded with money for missabings."
